verdict.rationale: Databricks documents Auto Loader for incrementally processing new files as they arrive in cloud storage. It pairs this with Lakeflow pipelines for deployed ETL, standard ingestion connectors, and Structured Streaming with low latency and exactly-once Delta sinks. A community user notes that the managed Spark setup removes infrastructure wiring. missing for 10: explicit evidence that ingestion runs as a fully managed/serverless service with no user-run infrastructure, explicit coverage of event-stream sources (e.g. message buses), and independent hands-on corroboration of continuous ingestion.
